ns2:section.sectionText: Application of communication skills for disseminating information in agriculture, consumer and environmental sciences. Students will analyze their current communication skills and acquire knowledge on how to improve those skills. The course will focus on interpersonal communication skills, small group interaction, impromptu and asynchronous delivery formats, and professional presentations. Students must register for a discussion section and the lecture AL1 - CRN 56362. Seats may be reserved by class level or major. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://hcd.uiuc.edu/prospective/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
